myAppsHelp: All your apps in one place. Open one to keep working on it, or start a new one.
designerHelp: Describe a website in your own words and the AI designs it, then keeps changing it as you ask.
gamesHelp: Describe a game and the AI builds a real, playable game step by step. You can play it as it grows.
resellerHelp: Manage your clients, your brand, your prices and your web address.
adminHelp: Settings for the whole platform: branding, AI, email, payments, users and resellers.
helpHelp: Step-by-step guides. This opens the one for the screen you're on.
themeHelp: Switch between light and dark. Your choice is remembered; you can also pick “Match my device” in your profile.

impersonation.viewingClient: You're viewing {name}'s workspace. Changes you make happen in their account.
impersonation.backToClientsHelp: Leaves this client's workspace and takes you back to your client list. Changes you made stay in their account.
impersonation.stopHelp: Stops acting as this person and takes you back to Admin. Changes you made stay in their account.

helpTips.label: Help tips
helpTips.help: Turns these helper notes on or off. When they're on, hold your mouse over any button to learn what it does. You can also change this in Settings.
